summary: The review found several integration gaps around toolkit normalization, session-manager replacement, datasource serialization, secret ownership, and YAML persistence. The existing Studio schema is also not yet a uniform JSON Schema contract, and dynamic option endpoints introduce authorization and SSRF concerns.

suggestions.title: Make ToolkitSpec the single normalization boundary
suggestions.rationale: The repository has both top-level BotConfig.toolkits and nested ToolConfig.toolkits. YAML parsing preserves the top-level field, while create_agent_factory only inspects config.tools.toolkits and its registration loop is a no-op; AbstractBot initializes only the tools argument. Normalize both DB and YAML inputs into one ToolkitSpec path before bot construction, with duplicate-field behavior defined and tested.

suggestions.title: Rebuild session ToolManagers instead of registering overrides into reused managers
suggestions.rationale: UserObjectsHandler reuses the existing session ToolManager. ToolManager does not track toolkit ownership, and registering the same prefixed toolkit can raise ToolNameCollisionError while legacy collisions are skipped. A fresh effective manager per session/config revision, or an explicit toolkit replacement API, is required to guarantee defaults plus overrides replace rather than duplicate tools.

suggestions.title: Persist datasource descriptors, not DatasetManager constructor parameters
suggestions.rationale: DatasetManager.__init__ accepts catalog flags but no datasource union. Existing cloning copies DatasetEntry objects and, in one path, shares the same source object between agent and user managers. Define a serializable datasource descriptor plus a factory that creates isolated sources and applies data-plane guards; otherwise agent-level DSNs, query slugs, and per-user state cannot be safely reconstructed.

suggestions.title: Define vault ownership for agent-level secrets explicitly
suggestions.rationale: Vault credentials are keyed by (user_id, name), while Studio ownership is resolved from the operator and registry factory ownership is read from config.created_by. A session user cannot retrieve an operator-owned credential unless the build path carries an explicit credential owner or service identity. Add owner-scoped references, authorization, rotation, and deletion semantics before implementing hydration.

suggestions.title: Do not persist agent-level MCP auth_config in raw mcp_servers
suggestions.rationale: BotConfig already exposes mcp_servers, and the registry factory constructs MCPServerConfig directly from those dictionaries, including auth_config. MCP auth_config can contain tokens, passwords, and API keys. Agent-level MCP needs its own normalized secret-reference shape and hydration path; otherwise the proposed BotModel/YAML persistence violates the no-plaintext-secret constraint.

suggestions.title: Require explicit configuration metadata for generic toolkits
suggestions.rationale: The generic Studio path resolves arbitrary entries from TOOL_REGISTRY, introspects constructors, and invokes cls(**params). Name heuristics cannot reliably identify nested credentials or server-managed objects, and arbitrary constructors may expose filesystem, network, or credential parameters. Make config_schema/secret_params an allowlist requirement for configurable toolkits; keep generic introspection read-only or restricted to explicitly safe classes.

suggestions.title: Authorize and constrain dynamic option lookups
suggestions.rationale: The proposed Jira options endpoint would accept server_url-dependent lookups, while Querysource options expose tenant/program choices. Both can disclose data or cause server-side requests to attacker-controlled destinations if current_params are trusted. Require an approved connector/URL policy, PBAC and data-plane checks, and credential-bound lookup context; add tests proving arbitrary Jira URLs and foreign Querysource programs are rejected.

suggestions.title: Standardize the schema response as one top-level JSON Schema contract
suggestions.rationale: The current endpoint returns a custom params map; only Wiki embeds a Pydantic schema under params.config.schema, while DatasetManager uses constructor introspection. The existing agent form is statically typed and has no generic schema renderer. Define one top-level Draft 2020-12 schema envelope, consistent extension names, masking semantics, and oneOf behavior, then contract-test wiki, dataset, generic, secret, and dynamic-option cases.

suggestions.title: Add a real persistence contract and migration before exposing toolkit_config
suggestions.rationale: BotModel currently has no toolkit_config or mcp_servers fields, to_bot_config omits them, and the generic bot update path blindly calls agent.set for every payload key. The BotWritePayload model is a codegen descriptor rather than runtime validation. Add additive database migration/model fields, Pydantic request validation, build-path propagation, and rejection of unknown or malformed specs before the UI depends on them.

suggestions.title: Preserve the actual factory YAML path when editing toolkit config
suggestions.rationale: create_agent_definition writes under AGENTS_DIR/agents/<category>, but BotConfig does not retain category and the existing registry update path defaults category to general. Editing a factory YAML located elsewhere can silently move the definition, leave stale metadata, or make reload/delete target the wrong file. Derive the target from metadata.file_path, verify containment under AGENTS_DIR, and atomically rewrite then re-register that exact file.

suggestions.title: Version session overrides across agent reloads
suggestions.rationale: BotManager.reload_agent swaps the live bot, but AgentTalk continues to read the existing per-user ToolManager from the session key. A saved agent default can therefore be invisible to existing sessions, while an override for a now-non-overridable parameter can remain active. Store a config revision with session overrides and rebuild or explicitly invalidate on mismatch; test reload failure, existing sessions, and removed overridable parameters.
